Package com.nexuslink.core.diagnostics

Class ConnectionDiagnostics

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.core.diagnostics.ConnectionDiagnostics
public final class ConnectionDiagnostics extends Object
Runs an ordered list of connection-diagnostic probes (DNS → TCP → TLS → SASL → Admin, or whatever a protocol needs) sequentially, stopping at the first failure and marking the rest skipped. Each probe returns a short detail string on success or throws on failure (its message becomes the detail). The runner is pure and JavaFX-free — the probes carry the actual network I/O — so the sequencing, timing and stop-on-failure logic is fully unit-testable with synthetic probes. A per-step callback lets a wizard update its UI as each step completes.

    • run

      public static List<ConnectionDiagnostics.StepResult> run(List<ConnectionDiagnostics.Step> steps)
      Runs the steps with no per-step callback.

    • run

      public static List<ConnectionDiagnostics.StepResult> run(List<ConnectionDiagnostics.Step> steps, Consumer<ConnectionDiagnostics.StepResult> onStep)
      Runs steps in order. Each is probed until one fails; that step is FAILED and every later step is SKIPPED without being probed. onStep is invoked once per step (in order, including skipped ones) so a wizard can render progress live. Returns all results in order.

    • allPassed
